import json, subprocess, os, sys
cmd = ["/harness-state/.gbrain/hook-launcher/gbrain-hook", "/harness-state/.local/bin/gbrain",
       "serve", "--surface", "starter", "--advertise", "verbs"]
env = dict(os.environ, GBRAIN_HOME="/harness-state")
p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, env=env, text=True)

def send(msg):
    p.stdin.write(json.dumps(msg) + "\n"); p.stdin.flush()

def wait(i):
    while True:
        line = p.stdout.readline()
        if not line:
            sys.exit("server closed")
        try:
            m = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        if m.get("id") == i:
            return m

send({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize", "params": {"protocolVersion": "2025-06-18", "capabilities": {}, "clientInfo": {"name": "verify", "version": "1"}}})
print("initialize:", wait(1)["result"]["serverInfo"])
send({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "notifications/initialized"})
send({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 2, "method": "tools/call", "params": {"name": "recall", "arguments": {"query": "gbrain install check"}}})
r = wait(2)
text = "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in r.get("result", {}).get("content", []))
print("isError:", r.get("result", {}).get("isError"), "| marker found via MCP recall:", "7f3a" in text)
print(text[:600])
p.terminate()

Round trip:

3. An exact keyword search for "7f3a" found it.
